filters:

form:

    - name: Interests
      id: interests
      type: checkbox
      label: "Interests"
      values:
        - text: "Volunteering"
          value: "volunteer"
        - text: "Signature Gathering"
          value: "signatures"
        - text: "Receive Updates"
          value: "updates"
